content: Angkehlail me Wiawihong Daina
Rahn ehu Daina, nein Lia serepein ong Seikop, ahpw mwemweitla rehn lihen Kenan kei.
Sekem, nein Amor mehn Ip, kaunen wasao, e kilangete Daina oh mwahukihda, e ahpw angkehlailiong.
E ahpw kilangada uwen kaselel en serepeino, ihme kahrehda e inenen poakepoakehla oh song en kansenamwahwihala.
E ahpw ndaiong eh pahpao, “Menlao pekihda serepein menet ei pwoud.”

Seikop eri rongada duwen nah serepeino eh adsuwedlahr, e ahpw sohte wia mehkot pwehki nah pwutak ko ar mihmi nansapw, apwahpwalih nair pelinmen ko, e sohte mwahn mweseiseiki, re lao pwurodo sang nansapw.
Amor, semen Sekem, ahpw kohla rehn Seikop pwe ira en koasoia duwen ire wet,

ni ahnsowo nein Seikop pwutak ko pa lelodo sang nansapwo. Ni ar rongada ire wet, re inenen pwuriamweikihla oh lingeringerkihda kowahlap, pwehki Sekem eh wiadahr soangen tiahk wet oh kanamenekilahr aramas en Israel kan.
Amor eri ndaiong Seikop, “Ei tungoal pwutako, Sekem, men pwoudiki sapwellimomwi serepeinen; komw kupwurehla oh ketikihong pwe en pwoudikihda.
Kitail inoukipene en kapwopwoudipene neitail kan, kumwail mweidodohng kiht noumwail kan, a kiht se pahn uhd mweidohng kumwail nait kan.
Pwe kumwail en kak iang kousoanla nan sahpwet; kumwail kak kousoan wasa kan me kumwail anahne, oh iang wie netinetseli ni saledek, oh uhdahn sapwenikihla sahpw akan me kumwail kousoan loale.
Sekem eri ndaiong semen Daina oh rie ko, “Kumwail kupwurehla ei pekipek, I ahpw pahn patohwanohng kumwail soahng koaros me kumwail anahne.
Kumwail kilelehdi uwen pweinen serepeinen, oh soangen kisakis me kumwail anahne, pwe I pahn kihong kumwail soahng koaros me kumwail pahn peki, ma kumwail pahn mweidohng ie I en pwoudiki serepeinen.”
Nein Seikop pwutak ko ahpw wiahiong Sekem oh eh pahpao pasapeng widing ehu, pwehki ar lingeringerki riarail serepeino eh adsuwedlahr.
Irail eri nda, “Se sohte kak mweidohng riat serepeinet en pwoudiki aramas me sohte sirkumsais; pwe mehkot kanamenek reht soahngen.
Ihte se pahn pwungki ma ohl koaros rehmwail pahn sirkumsaisla.
Eri kitail ahpw pahn kihpene neitail kan re en pwopwoudpene. Se pahn mihla rehmwail oh wiahla kisehmwail.
Ahpw ma kumwail sohte pwungki at koasoandi duwen sirkumsaisla, eri, se pahn wahda serepeinet oh kohkohla.”
Amor oh nah pwutako, Sekem, ahpw pwungki koasoandi wet.
Pwutako eri mwadangete kapwaiada dahme re koasoanehdio, pwehki eh limpoakohng mehlel nein Seikop serepeino. Pwutaket me keieu wahu nan eh peneinei.
Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem eri kohla wasahn tuhpene en kahnimwo oh padahkihong aramas ako:

“Aramas pwukat me kadek; kumwail mweidohng re en kousoanla rehtail oh seiloakseli ni saledek. Pwe sahpwet me laud oh itar irail en iang kousoan loale. Kitail kihong irail neitail serepein kan pwe re en pwoudiki, oh re pahn pil kihong kitail en pwoudiki neirail kan.
Ahpw aramas pwukat pahn pwungki mihla rehtail oh wiahla kisehtail, ma ohl koaros rehtail pahn sirkumsaisla duwehte irail.
Eri, kitail sou pahn pil ahnekihla ar kepwe kan oh nair pelimen kan? Eri kitail mweidohng re en mihla rehtail.”
Eri ohl koaros en kahnimwo ahpw pwungkihda dahme Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem ndahng irail, ohl koaros en kahnimwo ahpw sirkumsaisla.

Eri mwurin rahn siluh, nindokon ohl ako ar weiweirengki ar sirkumsaiso, riemen nein Seikop pwutak ko, rien Daina ko, Simion oh Lipai, ira ahpw ale neira kedlahs oh waila kemehla ohl koaros en kahnimwo,
iangahki Amor oh nah pwutak Sekem. Ira eri wahsang Daina nan imwen Sekemo oh kohkohla.
Mwurin ara kemehla ohl ako, nein Seikop pwutak teiko pedolong oh kauwehla kahnimwo, dupuken ar kadsuwedihala riarail serepeino.
Re pil wahsang mahn ako, sihpw, kou, ahs, oh mehkoaros me mi nan kahnimwo oh nansapw.
Re wahsang kepwe kesempwal koaros, iangahki lih oh seri koaros oh dipwisoun nan ihmw koaros.

Seikop ahpw ndaiong Simion oh Lipai, “Kumwail kahrehiongieier nan apwal laud ehu; mehn Kenan oh Peris, iangahki koaros tohn sahpwet pahn kailongkiniela. Nei ohl akan me malaulau; ma re pahn ehupene oh mahweniong ie, atail peneinei pwon pahn mwomwla.”
A re sapengki, “Se sohte kak mweidohng re en wiahkihla riato lih me kin netiki paliwere.”
